description: HP-27 is the designated Registering and Licensing Authority (R&LA) office for the Pooh sub-division in the Kinnaur district of Himachal Pradesh. Operated under the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), this office manages vehicle registrations, driving license issuances, and transport permits for the high-altitude tribal border regions.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Pooh, District Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh
